text: City Councilmember/Businesswoman
Serving as your Mayor (2025) and Yorba Linda Councilmember, I have worked to preserve the hometown values that make our city the 5th safest city in California.
On the City Council, I have prioritized public safety, fiscal responsibility and protecting our quality of life. Together, we have:

Balanced every city budget while protecting reserves
Maintained the City's prestigious AAA credit rating
Opposed high-density housing projects
Invested in roads, parks, and infrastructure
Expanded public safety staff and invested in fire detection technology
Added two new Heli-Hydrants for fire response

I have partnered with the Sheriff’s Department to promote Scam Stopper programs for our seniors, continued my commitment to Love Yorba Linda, the city’s largest community service day, and served on the Placentia Navigation Center Board, achieving more than a threefold increase in successful housing outcomes.

If re-elected, I will continue to use my professional background in business and finance to advocate for our city and fight the unfunded mandates coming out of Sacramento. I will fight to preserve Yorba Linda’s unique character, for my children as well as yours, to protect our neighborhoods and ensure local residents—not state politicians—shape our community's future.
I respectfully ask for your vote for re-election to the Yorba Linda City Council.
www.janicelimforyl.com

text: Mayor/Business Executive
Yorba Linda has been my home for over two decades and I’m honored to serve the people of our community.
As your Mayor, I’ve worked hard to deliver results that strengthen the family-friendly quality of life which makes Yorba Linda such an amazing community. Our successes include:
Public Safety: Supporting the highest level of law enforcement protection for our neighborhoods has helped Yorba Linda become one of California’s safest communities.
Fire Protection: Expanding our city’s access to advanced fire-fighting technologies, such as aerial heli-hydrants, to improve wildfire prevention.
Education and Parks: Opening our exceptional City Library and Cultural Arts Center. Expanding youth recreational amenities like the Adventure Playground.

Affordability and Public Health: As your representative on the Air Quality Management Board, I have worked successfully to reduce pollution while stopping excessive regulations that increase the cost of living for families and seniors.
Housing: I oppose California’s flawed high-density housing requirements. Local residents, not Sacramento politicians, should determine the housing needs of our city.

On a personal note, I’m a husband and father of two children attending Yorba Linda High School. I have been active in coaching youth sports. I respectfully ask for your vote to continue serving our community. www.Carlos4YL.com

text: Professional Chemical Engineer
I'm running for city council because I believe the best ideas come from listening to residents, making informed decisions, and planning ahead. Every voice matters, and everybody deserves to be heard.

My commitment is simple: to be accessible, prepared, and focused on practical solutions that keep Yorba Linda safe, financially responsible, and an exceptional place for families, seniors, and local businesses. I'll work to preserve the character of our community while embracing thoughtful improvements that benefit both today's residents and future generations. These are the same characteristics I embodied as your Planning Commissioner for over eleven years.

Educationally, I am a Chemical Engineer with an MBA (accounting emphasis) and have worked for the state of California as a tax auditor and as a renewable energy manager for the County of Orange. My work career epitomizes my philosophy of public service. I have also done volunteer work with the United Way and City of Yorba Linda
This campaign isn't about politics; it's about service. It's about earning your trust through integrity, respect, and a genuine commitment to our community.
Together, we can build on Yorba Linda's strengths and ensure it remains a city we're proud to call home for years to come.
Listening. Leading. Delivering.

text: Engineer/Yorba Linda Commissioner
Elect Sean to City Council and bring back open, honest, and accountable leadership!

Yorba Linda’s future depends on leaders who are focused on long-term success rather than short-term political games. As your Councilman, I will work collaboratively with residents, businesses, and city staff to address challenges, seize opportunities, and ensure our city remains well-managed and financially strong. Through years of community leadership and volunteer service, I have worked to bring people together, build consensus, and make thoughtful decisions that serve the greater good.

As a City Commissioner, Love Yorba Linda Co-Chair, Rotarian, and Knights of Columbus Officer, I believe strong leadership begins with listening, being transparent, and making responsible decisions that reflect the priorities of our residents. I am committed to protecting taxpayer dollars, maintaining balanced budgets, supporting public safety, investing wisely in our parks, roads, and infrastructure, and preserving the high quality of life that our families enjoy.

As a proud Yorba Lindan, I am committed to preserving the safe, welcoming, and vibrant community that makes our city such a wonderful place to live. It would be an honor to continue my service to our community and to help ensure Yorba Linda remains a city we are proud to call home for generations to come.

text: Entrepreneur

My name is Raymond Potter, and I have proudly called Yorba Linda home for more than 26 years. As the owner and operator of an automotive business, I understand the importance of hard work, fiscal responsibility, accountability, and dependable service.

I am running for Yorba Linda City Council because I want to preserve the qualities that make our city an exceptional place to live, work, and raise a family. My priorities include opposing additional high-density affordable housing projects that threaten Yorba Linda’s character, promoting responsible development, maintaining a strong local economy, supporting public safety, and addressing growing concerns involving e-bikes on our streets and sidewalks.

As a longtime resident and business owner, I take great pride in our city. I believe council members should listen carefully to residents, respect differing viewpoints, and work collaboratively toward practical solutions.
I would be honored to represent the people of Yorba Linda and respectfully ask for your vote.
